Psychology Today profile

Reem Glasco is a Licensed Professional Counselor Supervisor in Texas, license 66562. Complaints about a Texas licensee go to the Texas Behavioral Health Executive Council, 1-800-821-3205. Nothing on this site is therapy, supervision, or a substitute for either. If you are in immediate danger, call 911. For a mental health crisis, call or text 988 for the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline.
